summary.text: Aaron Thompson is a Republican state representative who has represented District 98 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Aaron Thompson earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Kentucky in 2013.

His career experience includes working as an executive director and field representative in the Kentucky Governor's Office and Department for Local Government, and he served as chairman of the Greenup County Republican Party from 2019 to 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Postsecondary Education, Tourism and Outdoor Recreation, and House State Government committees.
